why: ONE shared contract for the sreality CDN transform, run against BOTH copies of the normaliser: scraper/image_storage.py `with_transform` (tests/test_image_transform_parity.py) and frontend/src/lib/imageUrl.ts `imageSrc` on the CDN fallback (frontend/src/lib/imageUrl.test.ts). Pinning only the template string let the two logics drift apart invisibly; these vectors compare behaviour. Expected values are literal - the chain is never URL-encoded ('%2C'/'%7C' are off the CDN's exact-template allowlist).

probes.why: bare URL - the CDN 401s it, so the template is appended
the legacy 749 mode-3 CROP chain is normalised, never passed through
a rot prefix chain is a per-photo fact - kept in front of the template
rot kept, the legacy serving ops next to it replaced
idempotent - a URL already on the template is unchanged
an UNRECOGNISED op is dropped, not carried - carrying it builds a chain off the allowlist, which 400s and parks the row terminally
format/watermark ops are ours to choose - dropped even without a res op present
a non-fl query param survives, in place, and fl is rebuilt last
fl moves to the end when another param followed it
two fl params collapse into one chain
an empty query segment is ignored rather than re-emitted
a fragment stays a fragment - the chain goes in the query, ahead of it
any sdn.cz subdomain is sreality's CDN
another portal's image URL is left exactly alone
the host gate wins even over an fl-looking query on a foreign host
